    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 8 in row]

    shape = [row[min(cols):max(cols) + 1] for row in grid[min(rows):max(rows) + 1]]

    copies = sum(value == 4 for row in grid for value in row)
    return [part * copies for part in shape]
